subject.title: [Feature Request] Add streamTo="parent" support for runtime="subagent"

question: Should native subagents be allowed to stream mid-run progress to their parent, and what content is safe to surface?
rationale: The implementation is not a mechanical guard removal: it changes child-session visibility and channel delivery semantics, and current docs/tests intentionally keep `streamTo` ACP-only for native subagents.

options.title: Approve bounded native stream
options.body: Add a parent-only native subagent relay for sanitized lifecycle or assistant-progress updates, with tests proving redaction, routing, cleanup, and no raw tool/thinking leakage by default.

options.title: Keep ACP-only streamTo
options.body: Leave native subagents on final announce plus `sessions_history` and document ACP or thread-bound sessions as the live-progress path.

options.title: Defer to parent-send design
options.body: Treat this as blocked on the broader parent-scoped send/progress contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/18967.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded native stream
recommendation.body: Add a parent-only native subagent relay for sanitized lifecycle or assistant-progress updates, with tests proving redaction, routing, cleanup, and no raw tool/thinking leakage by default.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the existing ACP parent stream relay, which is the closest implemented policy and runtime boundary to compare against.
